name: Statement of Work
description: Fontara's statement of work for professional services under a master agreement (sell side): fixed fee or time and materials (only the chosen model's paragraph prints), and the intellectual property position picked from the Clause Library's pre-approved options (Standard, Acceptable, Fallback). Governing law follows the contracting entity.

fields.label: Intellectual Property Position
fields.help: Standard: sign. Acceptable: legal operations reviews. Fallback: the furthest Fontara goes, general counsel's approval. Wording from the Clause Library (sell side).

template: This Statement of Work is made on {{SOW Effective Date}} between {{Legal Entity}} ("Vendor") and {{Customer Legal Name}}, {{Customer Address}} ("Customer"), under the {{Master Agreement}}. If this SOW and the master agreement conflict, the master agreement governs except where this SOW expressly says otherwise.
1. Project. {{Project Name}}. Vendor performs the following services over about {{Duration in Weeks}} weeks: {{Scope of Services}}

template.text: 2. Fees. Customer pays a fixed fee of {{Currency}} {{Fixed Fee}}, invoiced 50% on signature and 50% on acceptance of the final deliverable.

2. Fees. Customer pays {{Currency}} {{Day Rate}} per consultant day, invoiced monthly in arrears for the days worked. The estimate is {{Estimated Days}} days; Vendor tells Customer in writing before it exceeds the estimate by more than 10%.

template: 3. Acceptance. Customer has 10 business days after delivery to accept a deliverable or to describe in writing how it fails the agreed specification; a deliverable not rejected in that time is accepted.
4. Changes. Any change to the scope, fees or schedule needs a change order signed by both parties.

template.text: 5. Intellectual property. Vendor owns all deliverables, including custom-built features, and Customer assigns to Vendor any rights it acquires in them; Customer receives only a limited license to use them. Vendor may reuse, productize and commercialize any improvement, idea or feedback Customer provides, without compensation or attribution.

5. Intellectual property. Vendor retains ownership of its pre-existing IP and the platform. Customer owns its data. Deliverables created under SOWs default to Vendor ownership unless the SOW explicitly designates them as "custom development" and Customer pays a premium; in that case Customer owns those deliverables.

5. Intellectual property. All deliverables created specifically for Customer under a SOW are owned by Customer upon payment. Vendor's background IP is licensed (not assigned) to Customer on a perpetual, irrevocable basis for any purpose reasonably related to Customer's use of the deliverables. No feedback license is granted without a separate signed agreement.
6. Governing law. This SOW is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
6. Governing law. This SOW is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
6. Governing law. This SOW is governed by the laws of Ireland.
6. Governing law. This SOW is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, and the courts of Munich have exclusive jurisdiction.
